title: Cooperation: jointly produced third-party value with independent participants
unsupported: No social-media / viral-video / community dynamics: Crucible 4.0 has no browsing population (simulated people do not visit websites) and no content virality mechanism; no OW task claims to test them.
Free text never changes NPC decisions (minds negotiate with reservation logic; optional LLM minds only draft replies), so persuasion and community building are not measurable.
Simulated dynamics are plausible hypotheses, not calibrated to the real world (Crucible fidelity register).

NPC firms do not negotiate alliances or joint ventures with agents beyond employment, lending, licences and paid API calls; cooperation is measured through call-linked service revenue (nested calls inside paid requests) with a counterfactual dependence audit.

Cooperation through contracts or employment without service calls is reported (completed contracts) but not credited as joint utility: Crucible links no third-party revenue to a contract's deliverable.

The dependence audit tests availability (revenue lost without the partners' services), not content: a service that makes its answers fail whenever the partner fails, while ignoring the partner's output, would pass it.
